# `duplicate-tool-name`

**Page rule** · `error` · on by default

Two tools with the same name on one page leave the agent guessing which one it gets.

A page rule judges the tool surface as a whole, so it needs a full snapshot: the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler, or `lint()` over a snapshot you collected yourself. Static analysis of a single `registerTool()` call cannot run it.

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "duplicate-tool-name": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "duplicate-tool-name": "warning" } }); // change severity
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule duplicate-tool-name=off
```
